# Reanimation Design System

> Dark-first React design system for web, iOS and iPadOS. 115 components on RA (package @aurelius43/reanimation), CSS-variable tokens (--ra-*), Dark and Light. Bone Maestro theme and Performance pack included. Generated from Claude Design; never edit.

## Start here
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): hard rules, color jobs, live-show behavior, platform notes
- [Component index](design-system/docs/components/INDEX.md)
- [Guidelines](design-system/guidelines.md): voice, color, type, space, shape, touch, layers
